name: Skirmisher
author: voodoo573
description: Feat from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You are as swift and elusive as the wind. - Any form of movement you possess is increased by 10 feet. - Difficult terrain does not impede your movement when you have taken the dash action. - Your attacks prevent creatures from making opportunity attacks against you.
summary: +10 ft to all your speeds, ignore difficult terrain when dashing, and avoid opportunity attacks.
